title: 塔里克 · 宝石小拼图
description: 长发塔里克坐在桌前拼一朵宝石花，水晶肩甲闪着柔和的光。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Taric is an adult man with long flowing brown hair, a warm face, blue gemstone shoulder armor, and a recognizable crystal-headed mace. Give him a fully covering ivory tunic and blue trousers beneath the armor, with the mace resting securely beside a padded stool.
art_direction.scene: He leans over a small tabletop and arranges smooth colorful stones into a flower-shaped mosaic. The crystal shoulder pieces glow gently, one plain cup sits nearby, and a soft curtain frames the peaceful craft corner without ornate scenery. Keep the composition spacious and peaceful, with visible wax-crayon strokes, warm paper margins, and every important prop clearly separated.
art_direction.palette: gem blue, rose pink, ivory, warm brown, pale gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
